scope: Two actual bounded Meta calls with a public synthetic saved project; local real API/compiler and standalone logical preview. Separate browser captures use synthetic offline model transports. No physical or hardware-control validation.

live_calls.input: Can I reuse this workstation for other pipetting recipes? What software should I use and how do I write and check a protocol? Show the programming guide. Keep my current hardware, suppliers and preparation unchanged.

Keep the same Jubilee workstation, Corning 96-well plate and Opentrons tip rack, and keep the machine layout unchanged. Change only the preparation recipe: stock concentration 5 mg/mL, target concentrations 1, 0.2 and 0.1 mg/mL, with 150 uL final volume per well. Do not change suppliers or components.

local_tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_software_guidance.py tests/test_protocol_preview.py tests/test_software_guidance_integration.py tests/test_instructions.py tests/test_procurement_api.py tests/test_chat_foundation.py -q
local_tests.scope: Offline deterministic tests, including actual extraction parsing through in-memory HTTP transport and whole-API state preservation; no model requests.

chat_and_revision_feedback.scope: Synthetic chat transport; real React/browser; no model calls

limits: The saved project, logical template and preview do not execute hardware.
Upstream Science Jubilee configuration and a separately authored protocol still require actual controller/tool/labware commissioning and review.
Arithmetic and supplied reference bindings do not establish calibrated positions, physical fit, transfer performance, material suitability or real liquid handling.
Two successful synthetic requests are bounded integration evidence, not a measured usability study or broad live-model reliability estimate.
The portable snapshot preserves logical lineage while reopening with a new runtime project ID.
Protocol downloads are the exact files checked in the live rehearsal; the HTML guide is regenerated from the actual second-call project using the recorded source hashes.
hash_basis: Normalized Git index blobs for all artifact and source hashes; public fixture hash is the previously verified baseline Git blob.
